title: Resolve User Hostnames
description: On ticket messages submitted from the web interface (where an IP address is available), Deskpro will attempt to resolve hostnames for users.

settings_def.name: rdns_server
settings_def.label: DNS Server
settings_def.description: Enter the IP address of a DNS server to perform IP address lookups against. You can use Google's DNS at 8.8.8.8 or OpenDNS at 208.67.222.222.

settings_def.name: rdns_ticket_showprops
settings_def.label: Show Summary
settings_def.description: When enabled, a summary of IP addresses and hostnames for all messages in a ticket will appear at the top of the ticket in the properties box. Otherwise, hostnames will only appear in the tooltip that appears when you hover your mouse over the time in each message.

settings_def.name: rdns_ticket_showprops_agents
settings_def.label: Show Summary with Agents
settings_def.description: When enabled, hostnames for agent messages will also appear in the summary box (the above option). If disabled, only user hostnames will appear.
